detail.longDescription: # Catima 2.45.1 is out! Catima is a lightweight (loyalty) card organizer app for Android. This release fixes a crash when having the Wear OS syncer enabled but Bluetooth disabled, a long-standing issue with opening pkpass/pdf/images files over the network (such as through Nextcloud) and a bug where the list widget didn't update the order. https:// github.com/CatimaLoyalty/Andro id/releases/tag/v2.45.1 Coming soon to an app store near you. # IzzyOnDroid # FDroid # GitHub # GooglePlay
